title: About
heading: I design and build
bioParagraphs: I'm Lee Gordon, a product designer with more than 15 years of experience. I've worked at R/GA and DigitasLBi, in-house at Nokia and Covetrus, and most recently led design at Fold.

My work covers research, product direction, interface design, design systems, and code. What I make depends on what the team needs to learn. That might be a journey map, a prototype, or the production interface.
I currently work mostly on AI products. I focus on what people can see and control, how the system explains its actions, and how it recovers from mistakes.

timeline.description: Designing AI products and helping small teams turn technical demos into products they can test with users.
Led product design for Fold's Bitcoin rewards app, built its design system, and established a regular user-research practice.
Planned and ran research to help product teams understand user needs and make product decisions.
Designed products and brand systems for Lightning Network tools.
Directed UX for Nokia's connected-home platform, including setup, monitoring, and household controls.
Led digital product work for enterprise clients, including Qantas.
Designed connected products and digital services for clients including Nike and Verizon.
Designed digital products and brand identities for new and established companies.
Started my career designing digital work for clients including Nike and Verizon.
